Financial Markets

This module introduces students to the money and capital market environment in which business organizations operate. It presents an overview of the financial system and its various components, including financial markets, instruments, and institutions.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Discuss the structure and operation of financial institutions and markets.[Knowledge & Understanding, Learning]

+  Explain Government monetary policy and the term structure of interest rates. [Knowledge & Understanding, Application]

+  Evaluate short and medium to longer term financial instruments. [Analysis, Problem solving]

+  Analyse the derivative products available to manage financial risk. [Analysis, Application]
